sections.title: Text 1

blocks.zh: 王一雪：下班了！同乐，我今天正好要路过你们家那边，用不用我开车送你？
blocks.en: Wang: Work is over! Tongle, I happen to be passing your neighbourhood today. Would you like a lift?

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：谢谢一雪姐，不过您走您的吧，我一会儿还要去一趟健身房。
blocks.en: Yang: Thank you, Yixue, but go ahead without me. I need to go to the gym shortly.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：去健身房？你什么时候开始健身的？
blocks.en: Wang: The gym? When did you start working out?

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：我上个星期发现单位旁边新开了一家健身房。我最近体重增加了不少，正好想运动一下，就进去看了看。
blocks.en: Yang: Last week I noticed a new gym next to work. I have gained quite a lot of weight lately and wanted some exercise, so I went in to look around.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：感觉怎么样？
blocks.en: Wang: What did you think?

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：挺不错的。当时正好有打折活动，我就办了一张会员卡。
blocks.en: Yang: It was pretty good. They happened to have a discount, so I got a membership card.

blocks.zh: 杨同乐为什么想健身？
blocks.en: Why did Yang want to work out?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 因为他最近体重增加了不少。
answers.en: Because he had gained quite a lot of weight recently.

blocks.zh: 杨同乐为什么办了会员卡？
blocks.en: Why did Yang get a membership card?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 因为健身房不错，当时正好有打折活动。
answers.en: Because the gym was good and happened to offer a discount.

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 下班时，王一雪问杨同乐……，因为她今天开车会……。不过，杨同乐不回家，他要先……。他上个星期发现……，就进去……。他最近……，正好想……。那家健身房……，当时……，他就……。
prompt.en: At the end of work, Wang asked Yang … because she would drive past…. However, Yang was going to … first. Last week he noticed … and went in to…. Recently he … and wanted to…. The gym was …; at the time …, so he….

answer.zh: 下班时，王一雪问杨同乐要不要她开车送他，因为她今天会路过他家那边。不过，杨同乐要先去健身房。他上个星期发现单位旁边新开了一家健身房，就进去看了看。他最近体重增加了不少，正好想运动。那家健身房挺不错，当时有打折活动，他就办了一张会员卡。
answer.en: Wang offered Yang a lift after work because she would pass his neighbourhood. Yang wanted to go to the gym first. Last week he had noticed a new gym next to work and looked around. He had gained weight and wanted to exercise. The gym was good and offered a discount, so he obtained a membership card.

sections.title: Text 2

blocks.zh: 王一雪：同乐，你晚上不吃饭就去健身，不会饿吗？
blocks.en: Wang: Tongle, won't you get hungry working out without dinner?

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：我带了饼干、酸奶和果汁，一会儿吃完了再去。
blocks.en: Yang: I brought biscuits, yogurt and juice. I will have them before going.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：那你为什么不在家附近找健身房？吃完晚饭，休息一下再去，不是更好吗？
blocks.en: Wang: Why not find a gym near home? Wouldn't it be better to go after dinner and a rest?

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：离我家最近的健身房也要坐两站公交车，一来一回得半个小时，太浪费时间了。
blocks.en: Yang: Even the nearest gym to my home is two bus stops away. The round trip takes half an hour, which wastes too much time.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：确实。那这家健身房的教练怎么样？
blocks.en: Wang: True. What are the coaches at this gym like?

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：教练很热情，也非常专业，动作讲得很清楚。
blocks.en: Yang: They are friendly and professional and explain the movements very clearly.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：听你这么一说，我也想试试了。我现在都是在家看着视频练，动作不一定标准。
blocks.en: Wang: Hearing that makes me want to try it too. I currently exercise at home with videos, and my movements may not be correct.

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：好啊，那您也来吧。锻炼要科学，否则容易受伤。
blocks.en: Yang: Great, come along. Exercise must be done scientifically, or it is easy to get injured.

blocks.zh: 杨同乐去健身房前要做什么？
blocks.en: What will Yang do before going to the gym?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 他要先吃饼干、喝酸奶和果汁。
answers.en: He will first have biscuits, yogurt and juice.

blocks.zh: 王一雪为什么也想去健身房锻炼？
blocks.en: Why does Wang also want to exercise at the gym?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 因为教练很专业，能帮助她把动作做标准。
answers.en: Because the professional coaches can help her perform the movements correctly.

sections.title: Text 3

blocks.zh: 有人爱在操场跑步，有人喜欢通过打球锻炼身体，还有一部分人愿意去健身房健身，杨同乐就是其中之一。
blocks.en: Some people like running on the sports field, some exercise through ball games, and others prefer the gym. Yang Tongle is one of the latter.

blocks.zh: 杨同乐认为健身房火起来是因为它有很多好处——环境好、设备全，可以锻炼全身。另外，健身房里一般还有专业教练，能帮助大家把动作做准确，练习的效果也更好。
blocks.en: Yang believes gyms have become popular because they offer many benefits: a pleasant environment, complete equipment and whole-body exercise. Professional coaches usually help people perform movements accurately, improving the results.

blocks.zh: 仅仅经过一个月左右的锻炼，杨同乐就感觉自己的身体比以前更健康了。教练也表扬他取得了很大的进步，并鼓励他坚持下去，还说随着身体越来越好，人看起来也会更帅。
blocks.en: After only about a month of exercise, Yang felt healthier. His coach praised his great progress, encouraged him to continue and said that as his health improved, he would also look more handsome.

blocks.zh: 健身房为什么会火起来？
blocks.en: Why have gyms become popular?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 因为环境好、设备全，还有专业教练，可以让锻炼的效果更好。
answers.en: Because they offer a good environment, complete equipment and professional coaches, improving exercise results.

blocks.zh: 教练为什么表扬杨同乐？
blocks.en: Why did the coach praise Yang?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 因为他经过一个月左右的锻炼，取得了很大的进步。
answers.en: Because he made great progress after about a month of exercise.

prompt.en: Some people enjoy …, others like …, and some …; Yang is…. He thinks gyms … because …: the environment …, equipment … and people can…. They also have … who help people …, improving…. After only …, he felt…. The coach praised him for …, encouraged … and said that as …, he would look….

answer.zh: 有人爱跑步，有人喜欢打球，还有一部分人喜欢去健身房，杨同乐就是其中之一。他认为健身房很火是因为环境好、设备全，可以锻炼全身，还有专业教练帮助大家把动作做准确。仅仅经过一个月左右的锻炼，他就感觉身体更健康了。教练表扬他取得了进步，并鼓励他坚持下去，还说身体好了，人看起来也会更帅。
answer.en: Some like running, others ball games, and others the gym; Yang is one of them. He thinks gyms are popular because of the good environment, equipment and coaches who improve movements. After about a month he felt healthier. His coach praised his progress, encouraged him to continue and said better health would also make him look more handsome.

sections.title: Text 4

blocks.zh: 中国乒乓球队非常有名，常在各项比赛中赢得第一名，被叫作“梦之队”。为了不断提高自己的水平，队员们每天都要进行严格的训练。正因为这样，球队才能在比赛中取得更好的成绩，获得更多球迷的喜爱。许多年轻的乒乓球运动员都有一个梦想，那就是进入国家队，参加世界大赛，为球队赢下比赛。
blocks.en: China's table-tennis team is famous for frequently winning first place and is called the Dream Team. Players train rigorously every day to keep improving. This helps them achieve better results and gain more fans. Many young table-tennis players dream of joining the national team, competing internationally and winning for their team.

blocks.zh: 在中国，除了专业运动员，喜欢打乒乓球的普通人也特别多。连一些年龄比较大的老人都坚持打球，年轻人更是把它作为一种日常锻炼的方式。可以说，乒乓球是中国人生活中最常见的运动之一。
blocks.en: In China, many ordinary people as well as professional athletes enjoy table tennis. Even some elderly people keep playing, and young people use it as regular exercise. It is one of the most common sports in Chinese daily life.

blocks.zh: 乒乓球队为什么每天都要进行严格的训练？
blocks.en: Why does the table-tennis team train rigorously every day?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 为了不断提高水平，在比赛中取得更好的成绩。
answers.en: To keep improving and achieve better results in competitions.

blocks.zh: 许多年轻的乒乓球运动员有什么梦想？
blocks.en: What dream do many young table-tennis players have?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 他们梦想进入国家队，参加世界大赛，为球队赢下比赛。
answers.en: They dream of joining the national team, competing internationally and winning for their team.

blocks.heading: Survey

blocks.zh: 学校运动会就要到了，老师希望了解同学们的运动情况。请你根据上面调查的内容，写一份调查报告，不少于140字。
blocks.en: The school sports meet is approaching. Write a survey report on classmates’ exercise habits in at least 140 Chinese characters.
blocks.heading: Writing · at least 140 characters

answers.zh: 为了了解同学们的运动情况，我问了四位同学。他们都觉得运动很重要，不过选择的方式不一样。两位同学喜欢跑步，每周去操场三次，每次半个小时，因为不用花钱，也很方便。一位同学喜欢打篮球，每周和朋友打两次，每次一个小时。他说和朋友一起运动很快乐。另一位同学平时学习很忙，但每天晚上都会散步二十分钟。通过这次调查，我发现大家都有锻炼的习惯。只要选择适合自己的方式，并且坚持下去，身体就会越来越健康。
answers.en: I surveyed four classmates. All valued exercise but chose different activities. Two ran on the sports field three times weekly for half an hour because it was free and convenient. One played basketball with friends twice weekly for an hour, enjoying their company. The fourth was busy studying but walked twenty minutes every evening. All had exercise habits. Choosing a suitable activity and persisting can improve health.
